469: The {H{\sc i}} masses ($M_{\rm HI}$) given in Table \ref{physical} were
470: calculated from the total intensity maps after primary-beam 
471: correction using the following relation:
472: 
473: \begin{equation}
474: M_{\rm HI}=2.36 \times 10^5 D^2 \int S {\rm d} V
475: \end{equation}
476: 
477: where $M_{\rm HI}$ is in ${\rm M}_{\odot}$, $D$ is the distance of the galaxy in Mpc
478: and $\int S {\rm d} V$ is the total {H{\sc i}}
479: flux density in the total intensity map, measured in Jy km s$^{-1}$.
480: The {H{\sc i}} masses are in agreement
481: with previous single-dish measurements to within 20\%, implying that we are not
482: losing much extended emission due to missing zero spacings.

490: starts to decrease.
